verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs say iPhone Mirroring lets users 'see and use your iPhone right from your Mac', and the Mac help guide says you can 'View and control your iPhone right from your Mac desktop'. Calls from the Mac and remote Personal Hotspot activation add further phone control. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation (requirements, limitations, what can and cannot be controlled), independent or hands-on corroboration, and any evidence of support for non-iPhone phones.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can view and control my phone directly from my desktop

citations.quote: iPhone Mirroring lets you see and use your iPhone right from your Mac.
View and control your iPhone right from your Mac desktop
with the Phone app, you can make or take calls directly from your Mac or iPad
With Instant Hotspot, your Mac can remotely activate the Personal Hotspot on your iPhone when they are near each other.
